audience: delivery companies and dispatchers who run drivers and routes in Track-POD

useCases.title: Review a day's orders by delivery status
useCases.text: The AI lists the orders of one day filtered by delivery status, driver or route number, or only the orders whose status changed in the last 24 hours.

useCases.title: Check the proof of delivery for an order
useCases.text: The AI reads the proof of delivery: who signed, signature and photo links, driver comment, reject reasons, delivered against ordered quantities and cash collected.

useCases.title: Follow a route and its driver
useCases.text: The AI lists the routes of a day with status, driver, vehicle, timings and distance, and reads one route with its orders and the driver's GPS track.

useCases.title: Review driver vehicle inspections
useCases.text: The AI lists the vehicle checks of a day or of one vehicle, with checklist pass or fail, notes, odometer and photo links.

useCases.title: Look up drivers and vehicles
useCases.text: The AI lists drivers with phone, vehicle, depot and zone, and vehicles with plate number, assigned driver and capacity.

useCases.title: Create a delivery or collection order
useCases.text: The AI creates one unscheduled order for a client and address, ready for a dispatcher to plan into a route. It does not create routes.
